1. A system for analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including means for use in generating a user interface for display on a user terminal, said user interface showing a distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and showing the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing a risk tolerance level of the investor, and excluding means for adding an investment to the investment portfolio or removing an investment from the investment portfolio. (Currently amended)

4. A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including means for use in __performing the step of__ adding an investment to the investment portfolio. (Currently amended)

5. A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including means for use in __performing the step of__ removing an investment from the investment portfolio. (Currently amended)

9. The system claimed in claim 7 or claim 8, said another user interface including means for __performing the step of__ allocating a proportion of the investor's assets to each investment of the investment portfolio. (Currently amended)

10. The system claimed in any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are __not limited to__ fund managers. (Currently amended)

11. The system claimed in any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are __not limited to__ direct shares. (Currently amended)
